notes.title: High School Crisis adjusted release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hello from the team at CFK.

We would like to thank our dedicated gamers for their continued interest and support in High School Crisis. 

We were planning to officially release High School Crisis on November 7th, 2024 (Thursday); however, after a long debate about enhancing parts of the game's content and other game quality improvements, we've decided to alter the release date as follows:

 [b]> Initial planned release date:[/b] November 7th, 2024 (Thursday)
 [b]> New official release date:[/b] November 21st, 2024 (Thursday)

Our deepest apologies for any inconvenience this postponement may have caused, but this only means we'll have an even better game ready for you upon release.
We hope you'll be able to wait just a little longer for the release of High School Crisis. Thank you for your understanding.

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

Thank you.
